name: llmock Local LLM API Mock Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed local HTTP mock server and Node.js package for deterministic OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini API testing, including streaming SSE, JSON fixtures, error injection and request inspection; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Runs on your own machine or CI runner; no hosted inference, real model tokens or cloud compute included. Tests must redirect SDK base URLs to the local mock; mock fixtures are not real model responses. Use a trusted network and avoid exposing the test server publicly.
